newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC units H1 results mostly improved.
newsitem.headline: HSBC units H1 results mostly improved.

text.p: HSBC Holdings Plc said on Monday most of its principal group businesses posted improved first half results, excluding HSBC Investment Banking.
- The Hongkong Bank Group reported an attributable profit of HK$10.31 billion for six months to June 30, 1997, up seven percent on the year, it said.
- Hang Seng Bank Ltd posted an attributable profit of HK$4.98 billion, up 15 percent from a year earlier period.
- Midland Bank reported an attributable profit of 512 million stg, an increase of 17 percent on the year.
- HSBC Americas Inc posted a 32 percent rise in attributable profit to US$232 million.
- The British Bank of the Middle East posted an attributable profit of 39 million stg, up 22 percent on the year.
- Hongkong Bank Malaysia Berhad reported an attributable profit of 179 million ringgit, up 14 percent on the year.
- Hongkong Bank of Canada reported a 20 percent rise in attributable profit to C$65 million for six months to June 30.
- HSBC Investment Banking posted an attributable profit of 92 million stg, down 33 percent from a year earlier period, the HSBC statement said.
